description: Editorial hero with content anchored to the corners of the viewport (headline bottom-left, description right, CTA bottom-right), tall scroll spacers between sections, a 3-column offset feature grid, and a minimal bordered footer. Cinematic, premium, sporty/luxury feel.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

PAGE STRUCTURE (App.tsx):
<ScrollFrames /> first, then a fixed header, then <main className="relative z-10"> containing: Hero (100dvh) → Feature section → Details section → Footer. Sections sit DIRECTLY adjacent — no spacer divs anywhere.

FIXED HEADER: logo/wordmark left; 4-5 small uppercase tracking-widest nav links right; one small pill CTA. Transparent background, no border. Nav links smooth-scroll to section ids.

HERO (h-[100dvh], w-[90%] mx-auto, flex column): a 12-column grid on desktop. Oversized display headline (clamp, 2 lines, tight leading) anchored bottom-left spanning ~7 columns; a short description paragraph mid-right (~4 columns, small text, 60% opacity); a two-part pill CTA bottom-right (label segment + arrow segment with a 1px gap). Elements fade-up in with a small stagger on load. The hero content (headline, description, CTA) is visible in the FIRST viewport, layered over the video — the page never opens on an empty viewport of bare video, and no spacer comes before the hero.

FEATURE SECTION (min-h-[100dvh], centered content, max-w-6xl): a small uppercase eyebrow naming the topic, one large statement heading that reveals word-by-word on scroll (Framer Motion whileInView with staggered spans), then a 3-column grid where the middle column is offset vertically (translate-y) for asymmetry. Each cell: thin 1px top border, small numbered label, short title, 2-line description. No card backgrounds — transparent with borders only.

DETAILS SECTION (min-h-[100dvh], w-[90%] mx-auto, flex items-center): a 2-column split — left: a large statement heading (sticky top-24 on desktop); right: 3-4 numbered rows, each a 1px-top-border block (two-digit number, short title, one-line description) fading in sequentially whileInView.

FOOTER (final section, sits at the absolute bottom of the scroll): TRANSPARENT (no fill, no blur, no panel) — the video shows through. A big CTA headline + solid accent pill button, a 4-column link grid, and a thin copyright bar, all separated by 1px borders (border-white/15 or border-black/15 per the brief's text scheme). No glass.

MOTION: Framer Motion only. Fade/slide whileInView reveals, hover states on nav (label slides up, duplicate slides in from below). Nothing bouncy.

prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

PAGE STRUCTURE (App.tsx):
<ScrollFrames /> first, then <PillNav /> (fixed), then a relative container ~250vh tall containing <FloatingHeadline /> (fixed text layer) and <BorderedPanel /> (absolute bottom-0), then a slim footer section.

PILL NAV (fixed, centered horizontally, top-6, z-50): a circular logo pill (48px, solid fill, simple inline-SVG glyph) + an adjacent rounded pill bar with 3-4 nav items (uppercase, 13-14px, tracked). Each item is its own small pill; on hover the label slides up and a duplicate label in inverted colors slides in from below (Framer Motion). Entry: logo scales in with a spring, items fade in with slight delay. On mobile collapse items into a hamburger with a small dropdown. Nav items smooth-scroll (element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})) — no scroll libraries.

FLOATING HEADLINE: fixed inset-0, flex column justify-end, p-4 md:p-8, pointer-events-none, z-10. Two lines of display text at clamp(4rem, 15vw, 18rem), line-height 0.85. Wrap each character in an inline-block span; drive a per-character exit animation from scroll position (useScroll + useTransform, or a scroll-linked variants stagger): characters translate down, squash slightly (scaleY up / scaleX down) and fade as the user scrolls the first ~600px. The full headline is visible immediately on load in the FIRST viewport, layered over the video — the page never opens on an empty viewport of bare video.

BORDERED PANEL (absolute bottom-0 of the 250vh container — this container is the scroll stage for the reveal, not empty space; the fixed headline stays on screen throughout it): a max-w-6xl h-[85vh] max-h-[900px] rounded-3xl panel with a 1px border (border-white/20 or border-black/20 per the brief's text scheme) and NO fill and NO blur — the video shows through it. It slides up from below the viewport tied to scroll progress (y: 100% → 0% via useScroll on the container). Optional gentle mouse-parallax tilt (a few px translate + 2-3deg rotate, spring-smoothed). Inside, centered: a small italic eyebrow, one very large serif-or-display statement heading (a few words italicized or accented), and at the bottom a full-width marquee strip (uppercase names separated by generous padding, translateX loop at ~20s, 40% opacity, 1px top border).

FOOTER (after the container): minimal single-row footer — wordmark left, 3-4 links right, thin top border, transparent background.

MOTION: Framer Motion only (useScroll, useTransform, springs). No GSAP, no scroll libraries, no manual rAF loops.
